status: PROTOCOL_V2 pre-registration input. Computed from OLD data only (v1 J1/J2/J3/J3b records and historical fs_post_freeze.json); no fresh-holdout data used.

evidence: J1 arms A2 (lr 2.5e-3) and A3 (lr 1.25e-3) are bitwise the first 32 updates of v1 J3 / J3b (losses, grad norms and parameter norms equal for all 32 updates).

At H=32 on the training side: A2 Q2 stable (0 clips, max per-visit ratio 1.0000, no epoch onset; epoch means 0.03185, 0.03162, 0.03140, 0.03120), Q3 8/8, Q4 train 24h mean 0.9741 / max 0.9800, Q5 train 72h 0.9924. A3: Q2 stable, Q3 8/8, Q4 0.9839 / max 0.9877, Q5 0.9886.

Old (now exposed) holdout, informational only: at H=32 holdout 24h 0.9994 (A2) and 0.9954 (A3); at H=256 1.0389 (J3) and 1.0204 (J3b). The holdout harm is produced by repeated fitting (X1 findings, X1-F7).

No other length has any holdout evidence: the saved records hold panels only at update 32 (J1) and 256 (J2/J3/J3b/X1). Evaluating 24 or 40 would need new GPU jobs on old data, outside the 4-job v2 budget; the training-side curves at 32 are still smoothly decreasing and say nothing about a generalization optimum. H=32 is therefore kept, not tuned.
H_choice.determinism_consequence: Training under the certified backend is bitwise reproducible (v1 J3-F2). The v2 primary replicas will replay J1 A2 exactly on the training side (and the fallback J1 A3), so Q1-Q5 outcomes are effectively known in advance (all PASS). The confirmatory content of v2 is Q0 validity plus Q6 on the untouched 2019 holdout.

merge_gate_risk_for_the_freeze_job.rule: pre-registered in v1 and carried over unchanged: atol = max(1e-5, 1.5e-3 * delta_max_abs), rtol = 1e-5, elementwise allclose on the 4-step rollout, TF32 off
merge_gate_risk_for_the_freeze_job.historical_evidence: 32-update gradient_check freezes at lr 1e-2 (pt-2r6tbwu7 / pt-sgc0joda, TF32 off inside the check): delta_max_abs ~0.068, branch-vs-merged max_abs_diff 3.8e-5 .. 5.4e-5, self_max_abs_diff 0.0. The v1 rule would give atol ~1.0e-4: about 2x margin. Longer fits (delta 0.5-2.2) had diffs 1.1e-4 .. 7.6e-4 against rule atol 7.8e-4 .. 3.2e-3.
merge_gate_risk_for_the_freeze_job.expectation: At H=32 and lr 2.5e-3 the Adam displacement is ~4x smaller than at lr 1e-2, so delta_max_abs ~0.017 and atol ~2.6e-5; if the diff scales with delta (as the historical data suggest) the margin stays ~2x. This is a risk, not a certainty; the tolerance is NOT adjusted.
